raw.body: Sprint goal: introduce /api/auth/tokens/v2 with `tenantId` and `scopes` fields. Token payload design is still being finalized — waiting on PM sign-off for the scopes schema. Atlas team is blocked on this for their premium tier gating. Refs LMNE-22.

title: Fix theme flickering on dark mode toggle

raw.author: kai-zhang
raw.body: Theme flash on toggle — context initialization is async, causing a frame of wrong theme on first paint. Working on a synchronous initialization fix. Fixes LMNE-18.

title: Refactor component library to use design tokens

raw.author: kai-zhang
raw.body: Large refactor migrating hardcoded hex values and spacing to Figma-synced design tokens. Required for dark mode and brand refresh. ~60% complete. Refs LMNE-21.

title: Fix performance regression in data grid virtualization

raw.author: priya-nair
raw.body: Data grid re-rendering entire virtual window on scroll. Root cause: unstable row identity — re-creating row objects on each render. Working on useMemo fix. P99 scroll jank is 180ms currently. Fixes LMNE-20.

title: Upgrade React to 18.3 and enable concurrent features

raw.author: kai-zhang
raw.body: Upgrading React 18.2 → 18.3. Migrating from legacy ReactDOM.render to createRoot. Identified 8 useLegacyRef call sites to migrate. Refs LMNE-19.

title: Fix accessibility issues on form inputs (WCAG AA)

raw.author: priya-nair
raw.body: Q1 accessibility audit flagged 9 axe violations on form inputs. Adding aria-label, aria-describedby, and visible focus rings. Fixes LMNE-17.
